import numpy as np

A = np.array([[1, 2, 3],
              [0, 1, 4],
              [5, 6, 0]])

B = np.array([[2, 0, 1],
              [3, 1, 0],
              [0, 2, 1]])

matrix_sum = A + B

matrix_product = A @ B

A_transpose = A.T

A_inverse = np.linalg.inv(A)

identity_check = A @ A_inverse

print(f"Matrix A:\n{A}")
print(f"Matrix B:\n{B}")
print(f"Sum:\n{matrix_sum}")
print(f"Product:\n{matrix_product}")
print(f"Transpose of A:\n{A_transpose}")
print(f"Inverse of A:\n{A_inverse}")
print(f"Identity check:\n{np.round(identity_check)}")
